meta.title: ArcGuard — report Arc porting pitfalls
meta.description: Paste a public GitHub repository or a Solidity file and read the ArcGuard example report. Arc testnet only.
hero.title: ArcGuard finds the pitfalls of porting to Arc
hero.lede: Paste a public GitHub repository URL or a .sol file. The report explains each finding in Spanish, English, or Portuguese and links the exact Arc documentation section.
hero.disclaimer: ArcGuard does not certify security and does not replace an audit. Arc testnet only (chain 5042002). An example report does not mean a contract is safe.
scan.githubHint: Example: https://github.com/Simonethg/scaffold-arc. https only, with no user or credential in the URL.
scan.pasteHint: It is read in the browser and sent only to this app's API. There is no analytics and no third-party service. The temp file is deleted when the call finishes.
scan.help: Fill in the URL or the file, not both.
scan.error.invalid-json: The request could not be read.
scan.error.empty: Paste a GitHub URL or a .sol file.
scan.error.both: Send the URL or the file, not both at once.
scan.error.invalid-github-url: The URL must be a public repository https://github.com/owner/repository.
scan.error.too-large: The file is over the 100000 character limit.
scan.error.not-solidity: The text does not look like Solidity. It needs pragma, contract, library, or interface.
scan.error.network: This app's API could not be reached.
report.staticBanner: This is the bundled example report. It is not a live scan and it does not call the network. The reference findings are in scaffold-arc NaiveEthereumPort. The rest are illustrative snippets, one per rule, so you can read the report format.
report.apiExampleBanner: The CLI did not return a JSON report, so this is still the bundled example. It is not a scan of what you pasted.
report.cliBanner: Report returned by arcaudit inside the sandbox. ArcGuard does not certify security.
report.referenceMatch: The target you entered is the reference repository for this example.
report.note.missing: arcaudit is not on the API environment.
report.note.not-implemented: arcaudit answered that scan is not implemented yet. No detectors ran.
report.note.not-json: arcaudit ran, but the output was not an Arc testnet JSON report.
report.note.timeout: arcaudit did not finish in time. The sandbox process was stopped.
report.title: Report
report.referenceNote: These two findings are in the published scaffold-arc file.
report.illustrativeNote: These snippets do not come from a scanned repository. They show how each rule reads.
report.usdcUnitsNa: UsdcUnits is not the fix for this rule.
report.counts: {total} findings: {high} high severity and {medium} medium severity.
report.empty: The CLI returned no findings. That does not certify the contract as safe.
rules.title: v0.1 rules
rules.lede: Each page has the problem, a vulnerable example, the fix, and the link to the docs.arc.io section. Detectors do not run yet.
rule.status: Implemented. ARC-001..ARC-008 run with slither --detect arc-... and arcaudit scan --chain arc. ARC-OFF-1 runs with arcaudit scan (offchain/).
rule.usdcUnitsNa: UsdcUnits does not apply to this rule. The fix is in the block above.
footer.disclaimer: ArcGuard does not certify security and does not replace an audit. Same stance Arc publishes on Security on Arc.
notFound.title: That page is not here
notFound.body: The rule or the route does not exist in this version.
